title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Dow jumps over 550 pts on Middle East deal hopes; healthcare stocks in focus - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Main ​U.S. stock ​indexes opened higher ​on Monday as signs of de-escalating tensions in ‌the Middle ⁠East dragged ⁠down crude ​prices, while investors prepared for ​another week packed with earnings and economic ​data.

AI-linked stocks will remain in focus this week as Palantir, Advanced Micro Devices, SanDisk and Western Digital prepare to report results. Micron shares fell 3.2% after Reuters reported that CXMT was considering a second memory-chip facility in Beijing and discussing financing with a local government-backed technology manufacturing hub.

Brent crude fell 5% after US President Donald Trump said talks with Iran on reopening the Strait of Hormuz would take place on Monday, though Tehran disputed his claim. The two-year Treasury yield dropped 5.4 basis points as investors weighed the economic impact of elevated energy costs since the conflict began.

Healthcare stocks drew attention after a report said Bristol Myers Squibb and AstraZeneca had held preliminary merger discussions. A deal could create one of the world’s largest drugmakers, valued at nearly $400 billion. Bristol Myers shares rose 6% in premarket trading, while AstraZeneca fell 5%.

US stock futures advanced on Monday as signs of easing tensions in the Middle East pushed crude prices lower, while investors awaited a busy week of corporate earnings and economic data. Dow futures climbed 466 points, or 0.89%, S&P 500 futures gained 40.25 points, or 0.54%, and Nasdaq 100 futures rose 80.5 points, or 0.28%, as of 7:15 a.m. ET.US stock futures advanced on Monday as signs of easing tensions in the Middle East pushed crude prices lower, while investors awaited a busy week of corporate earnings and economic data.
